CITI INDIA
Interview+Internship Experience
Kalyani Shirsath - Btech in Information Technology
STIPEND : 75000/MONTH
LOCATION : PUNE
Criteria: CPI 7+
Timeline :
PPT : 6th September 2022
Online Test: 11th September 2022 (9.00 pm -11.00 pm)
Technical Interview : 14th September 2022
HR Interview : 14th September 2022

PPT:
The PPT was conducted on 6th September.The PPT was very conclusive and
detailed. They explained everything about Citibank and what it does. They
explained the paper pattern and the platform on which the test would be
conducted. Do attend the PPT as if you get selected you may have to face some HR
questions that require the knowledge about the company and you won’t prefer to
have that last minute hustle searching over for it on Google. Make note of
important points.
Online Test:
The Test was conducted on AMCAT platform The Test consisted of 5 sections.
There were sectional timers. You cannot switch between sections. Also you cannot
navigate through the questions within a section. There was no negative marking.
General tip: Be fast in solving these questions as time becomes crucial factor for
elimination.
Sections:
1. CS subjects’ based MCQs (25 Questions in 35 minutes)
MCQs are based on stacks, queues, trees, searching, sorting techniques,
output prediction,basic programming questions,OOPS, debugging etc.

2. Aptitude (16 Questions in 16 minutes)
MCQs on topics like work and time, probability, permutations and combinations,
percentages, ages, profit and loss, etc.
3. Logical Reasoning (14 Questions in 14 minutes)
Questions on pattern completion,human relationships and puzzles on the
encoding of letters.
4. Verbal Reasoning (22 Questions in 18 minutes)
Antonyms, synonyms,logical ordering of sentences and passages etc. The questions
were easy.
5. Coding section (2 Questions in 60 minutes)
Question 1] Trapezium Pattern printing
The question in the AMCAT examination was a bit modified. The difference was
that we needed to print
“-” in the front spaces of the trapezium. Suppose that for input n = 4, the output
goes as follows:
Output :
1*2*3*4*17*18*19*20
–5*6*7*14*15*16
—-8*9*12*13
—---10*11
I was able to pass all the test cases (11/11) over here.

Question 2] was related to tree data structure
(I don’t remember the question.) Passed 2/13 test cases
76 students were shortlisted for the interviews
Technical Interview
All interviews were conducted on Zoom. My interview was scheduled at 3:00 pm
and I was the last one to give the interview in my batch. I joined the Zoom meeting
at 2:45 p.m. and waited in the lobby. The interviewer allowed me into the meeting
and was impressed by my early presence. The interviewer was really friendly.
Initially, he reviewed my resume and he told me he was impressed with my
academic achievements and my resume. He began the interview by introducing
himself and then he asked, “Tell me about yourself”.
He then asked me to explain about my projects. I used the STAR approach to
explain it. Then He asked me following questions based on OOPs:
1) How would you implement an interface in C++ ?
2) What is the use of an interface , how can we implement it?
3) What is polymorphism and its types?
4) What is abstraction?
I was able to answer all the questions correctly.

Then he asked to explain the logic of merge sort. I explained it in detail and he was
satisfied. He did not ask me to code.
He then asked me some theoretical questions about DBMS. I was able to answer
most of them correctly.
At last , he asked if I had any questions. (Do ask questions which will make the
interviewer feel you are interested.) I asked him two questions and his replies were
full of advice and his experiences.
As the tech interviews were being conducted simultaneously, people were being
shortlisted for the second round as well.
Regarding my selection for the next round, there was some miscommunication
and I wasn't informed that I had been selected for the next round. I was a little
tense here as I was confident about my technical round but still I wasn't
shortlisted.🥲
I was about to lose my hopes but then surprisingly my name was called for the HR
round at about 5:30pm. (So Be patient and don’t lose hope.)
A total of 32 students were further selected for the HR round.

HR Interview
After so much adventure during that period and I rushed over with my Laptop and joined the
meeting at 5:30 p.m. My second interviewer was also kind and generous. HR started the
interview with her introduction and then asked the following questions:
1) Tell me about yourself and your family.
2) Tell me about your today’s technical interview experience.
3) Explain about my project.
4) Tell me your short term and long term goals.
5) Why do you want to intern with Citi?
The interview lasted about 15 minutes and was a very nice interaction between us. After the
interviewer concluded my meeting and told me that the result would be announced shortly.
Finally Total 15 students were shortlisted for the internship and I was one of them 🥳.

Love Babbar's Cheatsheet , OS playlist

Love Babbar's Cheatsheet
DBMS:
Love Babbar Cheatsheet

IndiaBix

Tips:
Okay! So first of all breathe. Take a deep breath right now. You must have read a lot of interview
experiences and I can imagine how it feels.
1) It's never too late to begin, never! Just chaalu kardo.
2) Always read company archives on gfg(and practice questions company wise as well).
3) Give mock interviews as well (on interviewbit).
4) Be well versed with your projects. I used the STAR (Situation, Task, Action, Result) approach
to explain my projects.
5) Do not take HR round lightly. Prepare for it too.Read the most commonly asked HR
questions. Many candidates are eliminated in that round.
6) Find seniors (or friends) with whom you feel comfortable and you can willingly confide in
them everything that you feel.
7) Always try to stay calm and composed throughout your interview. Never panic or make
yourself feel weak in front of the interviewer. Be confident.
8) This would be the season of Internship drives and you may get stressed out as you see your
friends getting into various companies. Try not to panic yourself during that period because if
you mess up during that period you may lose many other opportunities.
9) Many times you may even face rejections in your various interviews and it takes the shit out of
you in that period. Do not let it disturb your preparation and mind.
10) Internship is not the only thing. Don’t be too harsh on yourself.
11) Don't lose faith in yourself if you get rejected, I was rejected in JP Morgan and Goldman
Sachs Interview. Analyze what you think could be a possible reason for the same.Take this as an
experience which will definitely come to your aid when you finally clear ‘THE Interview’.
12) Last but not the least, plan your studies properly and Trust the process :)
Phod ke aana..All the best..Trust the process
